_comment: Cessna 172S Skyhawk SP takeoff performance. THESE FIGURES ARE UNVERIFIED AND ARE NOT SHOWN TO ANY USER while verified=false — src/told.js hard-gates on that flag. They were entered from recollection of the type's published data and MUST be checked cell-by-cell against a real POH before the flag is flipped. A wrong cell here is not a display bug: a pilot could plan a departure they cannot make.

verification.requiredSource: Cessna 172S Skyhawk SP Pilot's Operating Handbook, Section 5, Takeoff Distance (Short Field)
verification.note: Flip verified to true ONLY after every cell below has been read off the POH page. Record who checked it and when.

source: Cessna 172S POH Section 5 — Short Field Takeoff Distance (PENDING VERIFICATION)
